{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS146 |prevtitle=Lively Lugia (Part 1) |nextcode=PS148 |nexttitle=Lively Lugia (Part 3) |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Lively Lugia (Part 2) |title_ja=VS ルギアII |title_ro=VS Lugia II |image=PS147.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 147 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|12}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 147 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|12}} |location=[[Whirl Islands]] }} '''Lively Lugia (Part 2)''' (Japanese: '''VS ルギアII''' ''VS Lugia II''), titled '''Lugia (Part 2)''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 147th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 57th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} With a frightened {{adv|Crystal}} as witness, {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Silver}} quarrel aboard half of [[Wilton]]'s fishing boat after surviving one of {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}}'s attacks. Silver starts to depart, ordering his {{TP|Silver|Croconaw}} to come along, but Gold assures his rival that the [[first partner Pokémon]] of all three [[Pokédex holder]]s are prepared to fight the menacing Lugia and that the trainers, regardless of their opinions of each other, should trust their Pokémon. [[Exbo]], Croconaw, and {{TP|Crystal|Bayleef}} attack as one, their elemental powers barely deflecting another of the Diving Pokémon's blasts. The boys quarrel further over emotional style and Crystal loudly questions {{adv|Professor Oak}}'s choice of Pokédex holders, to which Gold accuses her of being prissy. Nearby, [[Lt. Surge]] floats above the sea with the help of his three {{p|Magneton}}. He notes that Lugia's blasts, not being the result of any perceptible build-up of energy, are rather the results of Lugia's breaths, for which phenomenon he dubs the attacks {{m|Aeroblast}}s. Facing another of these, Surge realizes that if his Magneton were to take the strike, they would drop him. He then glances across the waves at Silver, noting that he must know a way to stop Lugia's attacks. Back on half of Wilton's boat, Silver has proposed that Lugia be drawn into the sea, where it will be unable to gather air for its terrifying technique. At close range, Silver proposes, brute force can be inflicted on Lugia's head and wings. However, he knows that Gold lacks a {{t|Flying}} Pokémon and will be of no help in the fight. Silver tells Gold to stay put with the three first partner Pokémon, and then summons his {{TP|Silver|Murkrow}}, while Crystal sends out [[Natee]]. However, as they take flight, they knock Gold into the sea. Silver and Crystal toss him a life-preserver just before his [[Pokégear]] rings. Wilton has called with an important bit of news and is floating right behind Gold, barely holding on to the other half of his boat, which contains a number of [[Poké Ball]]s. A tidal wave interrupts their conversation. Completely submerged, Gold silently ponders his predicament until he spots a wild {{p|Mantine}}, who is apparently cowering because of the blasts. Gold swims over to it, but then, his waterlogged body slackens pulling the rope on the life-preserver taut and then snapping the rope. The worried Silver and Crystal hear a dull rumbling from the sea. Suddenly Gold emerges with his new Mantine, which is supported by Wilton's school of {{p|Remoraid}}, two of which bite Gold's cue such that he can hold on as if to a glider and the rest face the other way in order to keep Mantine and Gold aloft with their jets of water. Affirming the Remoraid to be the best present he ever got, Gold tells Silver and Crystal that they will have to watch him defeat Lugia by himself. ==Major events== * {{adv|Gold}} catches a {{p|Mantine}}. * [[Wilton]] gives Gold a school of {{p|Remoraid}}. * Gold, {{adv|Silver}}, and {{adv|Crystal}} try to fight {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Mantine}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Crystal}} * [[Lt.
